author: PRANAV SHUKLA
description: Venkatesh Prasad has expressed his worries regarding India's team selection and tactical approach following their recent draw with New Zealand. Despite India's batting dominance during the Wellington Test, they fell short of a win, as New Zealand's defensive strategy held strong against India's bowlers on the final day. This result jeopardizes India's chances for the World Test Championship finals, prompting a reevaluation of their bowling lineup before the next Test.
title: 'Inappropriate, defensive strategy': Ex-cricketer slams Gambhir after draw

author: TNN
description: Delhi has been grappling with poor air quality for the last nine days, with predictions indicating a further decline. Reports show various city stations suffering from very bad air conditions, largely due to the impact of secondary organic aerosols. While some westerly winds have aided in dispersing pollutants, temperatures are expected to fall below 10 degrees Celsius for the first time this season, raising concerns.
title: Delhi AQI stays poor for ninth day in a row

author: KUSHAGRA DIXIT
description: Delhi's cycling safety is compromised by parked vehicles and wrong-way driving, according to a recent study. Cyclists face a significantly higher crash risk due to various roadside activities and poor road management. Eliminating on-street parking could substantially reduce non-fatal bicycle crashes, highlighting the need for better infrastructure. Researchers recommend dedicated cycling tracks and stronger enforcement against traffic violations to enhance cyclist safety.
title: What makes cycling risky in Delhi? Parked vehicles, wrong-way driving

author: ABHAY
description: Fatal road accidents in Delhi saw a significant increase by 7.7% compared to the same period last year. The total number of accidents rose by 13% from the previous year, highlighting alarming trends. Key factors contributing to these accidents include speeding and inadequate road infrastructure, according to officials. Experts emphasized the need for institutional accountability and greater investment in road safety measures.
title: Rising toll: Why Delhi continues to struggle with road safety

author: TRISHA MAHAJAN
description: Donald Trump took aim at Gavin Newsom's choice to commute the death sentences for 548 inmates, labeling it a disrespectful act toward victims' families. Supported by Attorney General Todd Blanche, who advocates for capital punishment, Trump's remarks resonate with his tough-on-crime stance as the 2028 presidential election looms. Newsom's administration defended the move, asserting that life sentences will still be upheld, underscoring the heated debate on capital punishment in California.
title: 'Terrible governor': Trump targets Newsom over decision to commute 548 death sentences

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: An Indian couple opted not to let their newborn daughter meet her grandparents immediately after birth. They prioritized the mother's recovery, family privacy, and adjusted to life as a family of three. This decision sparked varied reactions online, with some supporting it and others criticizing it. The discussion highlighted the differing views on postpartum recovery and the role of grandparents. Ultimately, opinions varied on balancing family traditions with new-parent boundaries.
title: Dad keeps newborn from grandparents for wife's postpartum peace, splits internet

title: PM Modi meets Nepal's Balen Shah, offers Rs 15,000 crore economic package

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Chokwe Antar Lumumba, former mayor of Jackson, was sentenced to 37 months in federal prison for corruption. He pleaded guilty to conspiracy to commit bribery in a hotel development scheme. The case involved other officials and alleged acceptance of money in exchange for political favors. Lumumba, once a promising political figure, faced challenges during his tenure, especially during the water crisis.
title: Mississippi ex-mayor gets 37 months in hotel bribery case, must forfeit $50k

title: Children are not toys, hear their voice in custody battles, says SC

author: TRISHA MAHAJAN
description: Jensen Huang returned to Nvidia as CEO after an independent investigation into his alleged extramarital affairs. His reinstatement followed a unanimous decision from Nvidia's board, satisfied with his transparency regarding the issues. Notably, Nvidia's stock surged dramatically, increasing by over 31% in a single day. Meanwhile, the Senate Banking Committee has scheduled a hearing for Huang on December 3.
title: 'Going to be a better CEO': Jensen Huang returns to Nvidia HQ amid applause; watch

author: SACHIN PARASHAR
description: In an unexpected diplomatic turn, Pakistan is set to invite India for a culture ministers meeting next year, marking a notable engagement since the Pahalgam terrorist attack. Following this, Pakistan will also host the SCO heads of state council summit in August. Although PM Narendra Modi's attendance is unlikely, a senior minister may attend, contingent on the prevailing security environment that will heavily influence India’s diplomatic decisions.
title: Pakistan set to invite India to a series of SCO events, but will Delhi join in?

author: TOI REAL ESTATE DESK
description: Hugh Jackman and ex-wife Deborra-Lee Furness’s lavish New York apartment, bought for $21 million in 2008, has reportedly found a buyer at its latest listing price of $28.75 million. The 11,000-square-foot, five-bedroom residence features stunning Hudson River views, a private terrace, a sauna and several luxury amenities. The sale comes amid Jackman’s relationship with Broadway star Sutton Foster.
title: Hugh Jackman's $28.75M NYC apartment with ex-wife finds buyer
